title: What Not to Erase: Saliency-Constrained Augmentation for Low-Resource Handwritten Character Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.27309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and handwritten character recognition (HCR) in low-resource historical material collections often rely on data augmentation, yet augmentation strategies are typically evaluated almost exclusively through predictive accuracy. This leaves open whether a model's improved performance is accompanied by saliency stability. This question is important in low-resource historical HCR, where recognition is performed on variable and partially degraded letterforms and two models with similar predictive performance may differ in how consistently their saliency patterns respond to such variation. We therefore study saliency-guided augmentation as an explanation-aware strategy for low-resource HCR. Rather than treating saliency maps only as post-hoc interpretations, we use them to define augmentation variants that perturb, preserve, or constrain visually informative regions of character images. translated_title: 什么不该擦除：面向低资源手写字符识别的显著性约束数据增强
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27309v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在低资源历史材料藏品中，光学字符识别（OCR）和手写字符识别（HCR）通常依赖数据增强，然而增强策略的评估几乎完全依赖于预测准确率。这就留下了一个悬而未决的问题：模型性能的提升是否伴随着显著性的稳定性。这一问题在低资源历史手写字符识别中尤为重要，因为识别对象是多变且部分退化的字形，两个预测性能相似的模型在显著性模式对这种变化的响应一致性上可能存在差异。因此，我们研究显著性引导的数据增强，作为一种解释感知型的低资源手写字符识别策略。我们不再仅仅将显著性图作为事后解释工具，而是利用它们定义增强变体，对字符图像中视觉信息丰富的区域进行扰动、保留或约束。我们比较了经典的……
tldr: 该论文提出一种显著性引导的数据增强策略，通过对字符图像中视觉信息丰富的区域进行扰动、保留或约束来定义增强变体，使低资源手写字符识别在获得性能提升的同时保持显著性模式的稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a saliency-guided data augmentation strategy that defines augmentation variants by perturbing, preserving, or constraining visually informative regions of character images, enabling low-resource handwritten character recognition to achieve both improved performance and saliency stability.
